title: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per sing
question:
Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)

prediction.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_spending
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customer_spending
    ORDER BY total_spending DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_avg_price AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) * 1.0 / SUM(t.XCL_017) AS avg_price_per_item
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_013 IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customer)
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013
)
SELECT 
    c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
    cap.avg_price_per_item,
    c.XCL_003 AS currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
JOIN customer_avg_price cap ON tc.customer_id = cap.customer_id;

FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001

ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
LIMIT 1;
